summary: Genome side is covered by public assemblies (9 NCBI records for S. mediterranea, incl. A2/S3 haplotype assemblies) and 6,382 SRA experiments; a Dryad set (CC0, 2024) holds population performance of S. mediterranea and Dugesia tahitiensis under varied feeding. Tumour incidence and actuarial ageing of asexual strains were not found anywhere, and AnAge has no longevity for S. mediterranea.
next_step: Compute heterozygosity/ploidy from the asexual-strain SRA runs or assemblies, and check dryad.v15dv425h's files for survival or reproduction variables; tumour incidence needs a literature compilation.
obstacles_confirmed: Lifespan and tumour-incidence numbers are not in the genome databases and are sparse for asexual strains.
Champions of regeneration is a comparative ranking without a single coded trait matrix.
